what: Step 4 entry-fence compatibility FINALIZE omits the set +e / rc-capture pattern spelled out for the Step 3b boundary fence
scenario_or_breakage: On FINALIZE failure inside the Step 4 entry timing fence, pipefail can end the fence before the repair warning and explicit exit run, so FM6’s hard-halt behavior may not hold on old paused sessions that resume at Step 4 without .completed/finalize
suggested_fix: In plan item 4 (and the Step 4 entry fence edit), require the same set +e, _finalize_rc capture, repair warning, and exit "$_finalize_rc" sequence as item 3’s Step 3b completion-boundary fence
